cases.title: Randomized controlled trial of semaglutide versus placebo in adults with type 2 diabetes
cases.abstract_text: Background: In adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, glycemic control is critical. Methods: A double-blind trial randomized 400 patients to subcutaneous semaglutide 1.0 mg or placebo once weekly. Primary outcome was mean reduction in HbA1c at 24 weeks.

cases.title: Comparative study of metformin versus lifestyle modification in prediabetes
cases.abstract_text: Objective: To assess diabetes prevention. Methods: 300 adult subjects with prediabetes were allocated to oral metformin 850 mg twice daily or intensive lifestyle modification. The endpoint was progression to diabetes at 3 years.

cases.title: Efficacy of empagliflozin versus glimepiride in patients with uncontrolled type 2 diabetes
cases.abstract_text: Methods: In a double-blind multicenter trial, 500 adult patients with type 2 diabetes were treated with empagliflozin 25 mg or glimepiride 4 mg daily. Change in HbA1c and body weight were measured at 52 weeks.

cases.title: Dapagliflozin in patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction
cases.abstract_text: Background: SGLT2 inhibitors improve cardiovascular outcomes. Patients with chronic heart failure were randomized to dapagliflozin 10 mg or matching placebo. Primary outcome was cardiovascular mortality or hospitalization.
